description: Áreas con condición de amenaza por incendios forestales para el suelo rural en centros poblados y nodos de equipamientos. POT Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. En el marco del Decreto 555 de 2021 "Plan de Ordenamiento Territorial de Bogotá D.C". Áreas con condición de amenaza por incendios forestales para el suelo rural en centros poblados y nodos de equipamientos. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. Its tags are Clasificación del Suelo, Determinantes Ambientales, Estructura Ecológica Principal, Gestión del riesgo, Medio Ambiente. It offers 6 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2024-11-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
